items.title: Document the current failure mode and scope boundary
items.context: Use the verified evidence: lattice.config.json validate.commands is a subset, verifier skips npm test fallback when configured commands exist, TEST writes test-evidence from lattice validate, DONE consumes test-evidence only, and pre-push is build/tsc rather than full npm test. This story writes the execution plan only and must not implement runtime gate code.

items.title: Specify the target gate design and rollout plan
items.context: Plan a robust solution such as DONE/release validation profile or doneRequiredCommands with fresh hash-bound evidence, self-host default requiring root npm test, external project configurability, emergency handling, migration, and false-positive/de-escalation policy.

items.title: Record validation and 3 round / 2 host audit requirements
items.context: Because this affects Lattice core DONE semantics, the plan must include concrete smoke tests, minimal commands, expected artifacts, and mandatory 3 round / 2 host review before implementation.
